summary: Odyssey Marine Exploration filed an 8-K disclosing that its Form S-4 for the April 8, 2026 merger agreement with American Ocean Minerals Corporation was declared effective by the SEC on October 15, 2026. Under the structure, a wholly owned Odyssey merger subsidiary will merge into AOM, which survives as an Odyssey subsidiary; consideration is Odyssey common stock. A December 2, 2026 special meeting will vote on the merger and a 2026 Equity Incentive Plan. Odyssey also announced a 1-for-25 reverse split effective October 28, 2026. Watch deal approval and Nasdaq listing mechanics.
